描述_EN: chiffre l embroidered in gold under the monogram h on the border necklace. black silk velvet, embroidered with gold and silver: semis of flames all over, collar of the order along the edge. upper part hidden by a large collar or mantelet of green silver canvas embroidered with the same motifs. the ensemble was lined with orange-yellow satin.
